title: Webapp
description: Creates a Link Loom React webapp (client or admin) that looks and behaves like Mi Retail workspace: the app shell, Veripass sign-in, Overview, Advanced settings with the platform hubs, language and theme, brand assets, Docker and tests. Layers add sign-up, the StoneOS launchpad and the Sommatic Command Center.

name.description: Product name people see: header, titles, share image (e.g. "Acme Workspace")

slug.description: Machine name: folder, package name, storage keys and the "Manage my app" route. Defaults to the name in kebab-case

variant.description: client: for the people who run the operation (routes under /client). admin: for the people who run the platform (routes under /admin)

en.client: Client — for the people who run the operation
en.admin: Admin — for the people who run the platform

es.admin: Admin — para quienes administran la plataforma

description.description: One sentence about the product: meta description, manifest and share image tagline

descriptionEs.description: The same sentence written natively in Spanish (neutral, with "tú"): the Spanish dictionary's description and sign-in subtitle. Without it the Spanish copy repeats the English one, with a warning

directory.description: Target folder, relative to the working directory (defaults to the slug); "." creates the app in the working folder itself, which must be empty

defaultLocale.description: Language the app opens in until the person picks one

signup.description: Adds sign-up and the organization setup (Veripass tenancy onboarding)

organizationSlug.description: Veripass organization slug the sign-in screen opens with (empty: people choose)

stoneos.description: StoneOS layer: launchpad sidebar, My apps, App Store, apps menu, platform hubs and help center from Link Loom Cloud

x-prompt.es: Incluir StoneOS (launchpad, apps, hubs de plataformas)

commandCenter.description: Sommatic Command Center layer: right panel, command catalog and Omnisearch category

x-prompt.es: Incluir el Command Center de Sommatic

platforms.description: Platforms shown as cards in Advanced settings, named by capability (Applications, Identity, Intelligence, Analytics, Devices, Finance, Operations, Learning)

brandMode.description: Where the palette starts: Mi Retail's (default), a preset, or a random harmonious one from `seed`. Colours given below override it

es.default: Los de Link Loom (la paleta de Mi Retail)

brandPreset.description: Preset palette when brandMode is preset

seed.description: Seed for brandMode random: the same seed gives the same palette

headerColor.description: Top bar background (defaults to the brand colour)

logoAreaColor.description: Background behind the logo, at the left of the top bar (defaults to the header a shade darker)

logo.description: Path to the logo for light backgrounds (SVG, or PNG of at least 512 px). Without it a monogram and wordmark are generated

logoDark.description: Path to the logo for dark backgrounds and the header (defaults to `logo`)

mark.description: Path to a square symbol for favicons and the condensed sidebar (defaults to a monogram)

backendUrl.description: This app's own backend (VITE_APP_BACKEND_URL): API keys and the app's domains

x-prompt.es: URL del backend de esta app

veripassApiKey.description: Veripass API key. Written only to .env.local, never printed. In agent mode prefer the VERIPASS_API_KEY environment variable

loomCloudUrl.description: Link Loom Cloud backend (VITE_LOOM_CLOUD_BACKEND_URL): App Engine, App Store, billing and help center. StoneOS layer

x-prompt.es: URL del backend de Link Loom Cloud

sommaticUrl.description: Sommatic backend (VITE_APP_SOMMATIC_BACKEND_URL) for the Command Center. Command Center layer

examples.name: Acme Workspace
examples.description: The operations center every role runs the organization from.
